title: Bag Items
summary: The non-cosmetic, non-crafting-material items that live in a player's Bag: per-gamemode trophy items, temporary coin boosts, and the openable pocket bags and crates. All of these are defined once in NetworkCore and are the same everywhere on the network. Cosmetics and gathering/crafting materials are documented separately.

entries.name: Parkour Medal
entries.description: Awarded for clearing a hub parkour course.
entries.how_to_get: Reach 50 jumps in a single Hub parkour run.
entries.how_to_use: Kept in the Bag as a trophy; there is no action button for it.
entries.icon_hint: a small gold medallion on a ribbon, engraved with a running shoe or footprint
entries.notes: Non-stackable - only one copy can ever be held.

entries.how_to_get: Get a kill in the Hub's PvP arena.
entries.how_to_use: Kept in the Bag as a trophy; there is no action button for it.
entries.icon_hint: a scuffed metal dog tag on a short chain, faint scratch marks

entries.name: Coin Boost 1.5x
entries.description: Earn 1.5x coins from Hub activities for 30 minutes.
entries.how_to_get: Found in crates and pocket bags.
entries.how_to_use: Activate it from the Bag to start a 30-minute 1.5x coin multiplier. Activating a second one before it expires extends the remaining time rather than adding to the multiplier.
entries.icon_hint: a small pile of glittering white sugar-like crystals with a golden coin symbol floating above

entries.name: Coin Boost 2x
entries.description: Earn double coins from Hub activities for 30 minutes.
entries.how_to_use: Activate it from the Bag to start a 30-minute 2x coin multiplier. Activating a second one before it expires extends the remaining time rather than adding to the multiplier.
entries.icon_hint: a swirl of orange-red powder with bright coin sparks and a bold x2 glint

entries.name: Coin Boost 2x (2h)
entries.description: Earn double coins from Hub activities for two hours.
entries.how_to_use: Activate it from the Bag to start a 2-hour 2x coin multiplier. Activating a second one before it expires extends the remaining time rather than adding to the multiplier.
entries.icon_hint: a glowing golden teardrop-shaped gem with a bright aura, larger and fancier than the shorter boost icons

entries.name: Small Pocket Bag
entries.description: A little bundle. Open it and see.
entries.how_to_get: The everyday reward from the Daily Chest and general play - by far the most common bag item on the network.
entries.how_to_use: Open it from the Bag for a guaranteed handful of coins, with a smaller chance of some crafting materials and, rarely, a bonus key or Common Crate.
entries.icon_hint: a small tied cloth drawstring bundle/pouch in plain grey-brown cloth

entries.name: Large Pocket Bag
entries.how_to_get: Daily Chest streak rewards and events.
entries.how_to_use: Open it from the Bag for more coins and two rolls of crafting materials, plus a decent chance at a bonus key, crate, or coin boost.
entries.icon_hint: a bulging, well-stuffed cloth drawstring bundle in blue cloth, larger than the small pocket bag

entries.name: Common Crate
entries.description: Needs a Common Key to open.
entries.how_to_get: Earned across the network - Daily Chest, quests, and everyday play.
entries.how_to_use: Open it (consumes one Common Key) for guaranteed coins, cosmetic-crafting shards and materials, plus a chance at a cosmetic or a bonus item. Trying to open one with no key just shows it locked.
entries.icon_hint: a plain wooden treasure chest with green metal trim

entries.name: Rare Crate
entries.description: Needs a Rare Key to open.
entries.how_to_get: A rare reward for big milestones.
entries.how_to_use: Open it (consumes one Rare Key) for a large coin payout, rare and epic crafting materials, and a guaranteed 'chase' bonus roll that can include a cosmetic. Trying to open one with no key just shows it locked.
entries.icon_hint: an ornate purple-and-black trimmed chest with a faint magical glow

entries.name: Beta Ticket
entries.description: You were here before it was finished.
entries.how_to_get: Awarded for having played during the ReimaginedCraft beta.
entries.how_to_use: A keepsake with no action button - it just sits in the Bag as proof you were an early player.
entries.icon_hint: a slightly worn paper ticket stub stamped with a star and the word BETA
entries.notes: Non-stackable, Legendary rarity - cannot be earned any other way.

open_questions: Whether Diamond Trophy, Elevator Chaos, Mace Crush and Survival will each grant their game item on a specific trigger (a boss kill, a floor cleared, a match win, etc.) is not yet decided in any config - today those items simply have no code path that grants them, so they only appear in the Bag as an uncollected collection-log entry.

A larger wave of new bag items (mostly cosmetics, plus two higher crate tiers) is planned in an approved-but-unbuilt spec and is intentionally left out of this list since none of it exists in the live item registry yet.
